title: Engineering All-Hands — 2026-03-11
content:
Date: 2026-03-11
Attendees: org-wide (engineering + product + SRE reps). Notes prepared by Aisha Patel (platform-engineering).

TL;DR
- Big wins: Serving-runtime 0.9.3 rollout completed to staging and 30% of prod traffic (latency p95 down ~18% for long-context workloads).
- Reliability: No major customer-facing incidents this week; two SRE-led follow-ups on background job spikes.
- Roadmap: Private deployment GA plan ready; dedicated capacity autoscaler beta scheduled next week.
- Action items: Finish telemetry migration for model routing by 2026-03-18 (ENG-2345).

Agenda
1) Quick metrics + health
2) Cross-team highlights
3) Incidents & postmortems
4) Roadmap updates & upcoming launches
5) People / hiring / shoutouts
6) Q&A / parking lot

1) Metrics + Health - Key SLOs (org-reported)
  - Serving uptime (prod): 99.98% (rolling 30d) — within SLA targets.
  - Mean token latency (hosted API): 72ms (per-token, nominal seq) — p95 reduced from 280ms to 230ms for 4k+ context by serving-runtime 0.9.3 improvements.
  - Cost per 1k tokens (hosted): trending down 6% week-over-week due to batching and KV cache hit improvements.
  - Customer error rate (4xx/5xx): 0.17% — small bump attributed to SDK serialization edge-case (tracked in ENG-2401).

2) Cross-team highlights
- Serving-runtime
  - 0.9.3 rollout: kernel selection optimizations and KV cache prefetch enabled. Staging -> canary -> 30% prod completed. Monitoring dashboard added under Console > Models > Runtime (linked).
  - Next: fragmentation fix for KV cache (PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/serving-runtime/pull/512).
- Observability (console-and-tooling)
  - Token-level cost traces launched to internal beta; early feedback shows per-route cost breakdown helps identify high-cost prompts.
  - Tracing improvements: span sampling config exposed in Console for enterprise customers.
- Private Deployments
  - GA readiness checklist drafted; legal review for support contract in progress. Packaging for on-prem appliance validated on 3 customer environments in alpha.
- Dedicated
  - Autoscaler beta for reserved GPU pools scheduled to open next week (signup link shared via #eng-dedicated).
- SRE / Platform Operations
  - Background job spike on 2026-03-03 (SRE-2026-03-03) — root cause: backfill job starved worker pools during autoscaler cooldown; mitigations: prioritized job queue + cooldown override.

3) Incidents & Postmortems
- SRE-2026-03-03 (backfill spike) — incident summary: multiple worker pools experienced high CPU due to legacy backfill; mitigations implemented and tested. Postmortem draft available: https://redwood.atlassian.net/wiki/spaces/SRE/pages/PM-2026-03-03
  - Action items from postmortem:
    - Add job priority tags and quota enforcement by 2026-03-18 (owner: Jonah Kim).
    - Add a synthetic test for backfill behavior in staging (owner: Rina Desai).

4) Roadmap updates & upcoming launches
- Private GA timeline: target 2026-04-15 for first GA customer (legal/compliance gating).
- Dedicated autoscaler: beta next week; full rollout planned across accounts by end of Q2.
- Optimize toolkit: early access is greenlit for three pilot customers — quality threshold and cost guardrails to be finalized (ENG-2398).
- Long lead items: expanded region support (APAC) — networking approvals in progress (network team).

5) People / Hiring / Shoutouts
- Hiring: we are actively hiring for infra SRE (2 IC roles), serving-runtime engineer (1 senior), and product observability PM (1). Recruiting contacts: Priya Singh.
- Shoutouts:
  - Miguel Torres for leading the 0.9.3 rollout and coordinating cross-team canary.
  - Rina Desai for triaging the staging KV cache issue and shipping the hotfix.

6) Q&A / Parking lot (summary)
Q: How disruptive will the 0.9.3 rollout be for Dedicated customers?
A: We have a compatibility matrix and rollback plan; Dedicated customers on pinned model/runtime versions will not be auto-upgraded. Ops will coordinate downtime windows where needed.

Q: When will we see cost savings flow to customers using Optimize?
A: Early adopters in the pilot are reporting 5-12% unit-cost reductions depending on workload; Optimize GA will include prescriptive recommendations and automated batching rules.

Action Items (owners + due dates)
- ENG-2345: Telemetry migration for model routing — Aisha Patel — due 2026-03-18.
- Job priority & quota enforcement — Jonah Kim — due 2026-03-18.
- Synthetic backfill test in staging — Rina Desai — due 2026-03-16.
- Finalize Private GA legal package — Priya Singh + Legal — due 2026-03-25.

Notes / Links / References
- Rollout PR (serving-runtime): https://github.com/redwood-inference/serving-runtime/pull/512
- Roadmap (Confluence): https://redwood.atlassian.net/wiki/spaces/PLAT/pages/6789012
- Incident postmortem: https://redwood.atlassian.net/wiki/spaces/SRE/pages/PM-2026-03-03
- Related Jira: ENG-2345, ENG-2398, SRE-2026-03-03

Appendix: quick standup logs (week highlights)
- Mon 2026-03-09: Serving-runtime canary 10% -> smoke tests passed. Observability launched token-cost traces to internal beta.
- Tue 2026-03-10: Staging KV cache regression discovered -> hotfix merged.
- Wed 2026-03-11: Canary -> 30% prod. Autoscaler beta dry-run successful in sandbox.
